finding: DeepSeek repeatedly describes the R167m impairment loss as an 'impairment release' and questions the 'sustainability of that release'. Because PBD assets have a cumulative impairment gain (+R431m), a reduction from R598m to R431m represents an impairment LOSS (P&L charge of -R167m), not an earnings release. impact: P&L credit charge mischaracterized as positive income; risks faulty earnings forecasting.

finding: Multi-tier grouped column headers (e.g. 3-tier hierarchies across 16 columns) cannot be cleanly represented in standard GitHub Flavored Markdown tables without colspan. Attempting complex programmatic table reconstruction across arbitrary company formats introduces fragile edge cases. impact: Avoids over-engineering table parsers; preserves generic, robust extraction.
